units.rawText: Right now, they are facing a massive display screen on a wall, which is playing footage of their training during the daytime.

units.rawText: After the last human fell out, the Doll force successfully took their mission objective and the mock battle came to an end.

units.rawText: Do you see how you performed?
units.displayText: Do you see how you performed?

spans.text: Do you see how you performed?

units.rawText: Scattered replies in the affirmative fill the air. Nobody here feels particularly motivated after seeing their disastrous performance.
units.displayText: Scattered replies in the affirmative fill the air. Nobody here feels particularly motivated after seeing their disastrous performance.

spans.text: Scattered replies in the affirmative fill the air. Nobody here feels particularly motivated after seeing their disastrous performance.

units.rawText: You can't fight worth a damn, and your replies are about as limp as the cigarette butt I'm holding. Are you military men or maggots? I asked you, do you see how you performed!?
units.displayText: You can't fight worth a damn, and your replies are about as limp as the cigarette butt I'm holding. Are you military men or maggots? I asked you, do you see how you performed!?

spans.text: You can't fight worth a damn, and your replies are about as limp as the cigarette butt I'm holding. Are you military men or maggots? I asked you, do you see how you performed!?

units.rawText: <size=40>Sir! We see, sir!</size>
units.displayText: Sir! We see, sir!

spans.text: Sir! We see, sir!

units.rawText: You worthless bunch of breastfed morons.
units.displayText: You worthless bunch of breastfed morons.

spans.text: You worthless bunch of breastfed morons.

units.rawText: Also, you two. This is absolutely appalling. The platoon leaders are actually number one from the back. Saves me the trouble of looking you up, at least.
units.displayText: Also, you two. This is absolutely appalling. The platoon leaders are actually number one from the back. Saves me the trouble of looking you up, at least.

spans.text: Also, you two. This is absolutely appalling. The platoon leaders are actually number one from the back. Saves me the trouble of looking you up, at least.

units.rawText: Sir, they were targeting me, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, they were targeting me, sir.

spans.text: Sir, they were targeting me, sir.

units.rawText: Sir, I was targeted too, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, I was targeted too, sir.

spans.text: Sir, I was targeted too, sir.

units.rawText: If you suck, then you suck! Why the hell are you making so many excuses for yourselves? What the hell did I teach you? If you suck, then own up to it! Take the hit and keep going!
units.displayText: If you suck, then you suck! Why the hell are you making so many excuses for yourselves? What the hell did I teach you? If you suck, then own up to it! Take the hit and keep going!

spans.text: If you suck, then you suck! Why the hell are you making so many excuses for yourselves? What the hell did I teach you? If you suck, then own up to it! Take the hit and keep going!

units.rawText: Right, that's it, everyone, form up!
units.displayText: Right, that's it, everyone, form up!

spans.text: Right, that's it, everyone, form up!

units.rawText: <size=40>Sir!</size>
units.displayText: Sir!

spans.text: Sir!

units.rawText: First off, Erwin, Evelyn, you are no longer platoon leaders! From today onward, you are the instructors for these 98 pieces of garbage. This formation will be called the Garbage Collectors.
units.displayText: First off, Erwin, Evelyn, you are no longer platoon leaders! From today onward, you are the instructors for these 98 pieces of garbage. This formation will be called the Garbage Collectors.

spans.text: First off, Erwin, Evelyn, you are no longer platoon leaders! From today onward, you are the instructors for these 98 pieces of garbage. This formation will be called the Garbage Collectors.

units.rawText: Like I said earlier today, you Garbage Collectors are stripped of your qualifications to take part in the Military Games.
units.displayText: Like I said earlier today, you Garbage Collectors are stripped of your qualifications to take part in the Military Games.

spans.text: Like I said earlier today, you Garbage Collectors are stripped of your qualifications to take part in the Military Games.

units.rawText: Python eyes the pale faces of the two former platoon leaders and taps the cigarette butt between his fingers.
units.displayText: Python eyes the pale faces of the two former platoon leaders and taps the cigarette butt between his fingers.

spans.text: Python eyes the pale faces of the two former platoon leaders and taps the cigarette butt between his fingers.

units.rawText: If you still want to take part in the games, then prove you're not garbage first!
units.displayText: If you still want to take part in the games, then prove you're not garbage first!

spans.text: If you still want to take part in the games, then prove you're not garbage first!

units.rawText: Starting from tomorrow, the mock battles will be changed to a 1v2 format. You Garbage Collectors will challenge two other normal formations, taking turns on attack and defense, with no restrictions on the tactics or methods.
units.displayText: Starting from tomorrow, the mock battles will be changed to a 1v2 format. You Garbage Collectors will challenge two other normal formations, taking turns on attack and defense, with no restrictions on the tactics or methods.

spans.text: Starting from tomorrow, the mock battles will be changed to a 1v2 format. You Garbage Collectors will challenge two other normal formations, taking turns on attack and defense, with no restrictions on the tactics or methods.

units.rawText: When you can beat the formation that scores the best, you'll be qualified to participate in the games.
units.displayText: When you can beat the formation that scores the best, you'll be qualified to participate in the games.

spans.text: When you can beat the formation that scores the best, you'll be qualified to participate in the games.

units.rawText: Sir! That's not fair, sir! There's a discrepancy in our numbers, sir!
units.displayText: Sir! That's not fair, sir! There's a discrepancy in our numbers, sir!

spans.text: Sir! That's not fair, sir! There's a discrepancy in our numbers, sir!

units.rawText: Fair? When you leave this training camp, who's going to play fair with you? Are you going to ask enemies piloting mechs against infantry or the pack of terrorists developing poison gases to play fair?
units.displayText: Fair? When you leave this training camp, who's going to play fair with you? Are you going to ask enemies piloting mechs against infantry or the pack of terrorists developing poison gases to play fair?

spans.text: Fair? When you leave this training camp, who's going to play fair with you? Are you going to ask enemies piloting mechs against infantry or the pack of terrorists developing poison gases to play fair?

units.rawText: Over here, your grades will be weighted according to the difference in numbers. I won't make things difficult for you in that aspect, at least.
units.displayText: Over here, your grades will be weighted according to the difference in numbers. I won't make things difficult for you in that aspect, at least.

spans.text: Over here, your grades will be weighted according to the difference in numbers. I won't make things difficult for you in that aspect, at least.

units.rawText: But don't celebrate too soon, because I will be commanding the two formations. Understood?
units.displayText: But don't celebrate too soon, because I will be commanding the two formations. Understood?

spans.text: But don't celebrate too soon, because I will be commanding the two formations. Understood?

units.rawText: ...Sir, that's favoritism, sir!
units.displayText: ...Sir, that's favoritism, sir!

spans.text: ...Sir, that's favoritism, sir!

units.rawText: Wrong, that's survival of the fittest at its simplest.
units.displayText: Wrong, that's survival of the fittest at its simplest.

spans.text: Wrong, that's survival of the fittest at its simplest.

units.rawText: Alright, dismissed. The second mock battle begins in three days. I'm looking forward to your performance.
units.displayText: Alright, dismissed. The second mock battle begins in three days. I'm looking forward to your performance.

spans.text: Alright, dismissed. The second mock battle begins in three days. I'm looking forward to your performance.
